newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks trade off lows after sharp poll fall.
newsitem.headline: French stocks trade off lows after sharp poll fall.

text.p: French shares traded above their lows after a sharp opening fall due to an unexpected strong gain for left-wing parties in the first round of a parliamentart election on Sunday, dealers said.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 79.03 points or 2.86 percent at 2,683.87 at 0909 GMT after having fallen as low as 2,645.68. The CAC-40 May futures contract was down at 2,683 from 2,761 on Friday's close.
Volume was 2.3 billion francs, limited by public holidays in U.S. and U.K. markets.
